subject.title: [security] Diagnostic fallback redaction can leave credential suffixes visible

question: Should this exact diagnostic fallback suffix leak be fixed as part of a consolidated credential-redaction security hardening change or tracked as a separate focused fix?
rationale: The source-level bug is clear, but it affects a documented security boundary and overlaps several adjacent open redaction reports, so maintainers should choose the security review and consolidation path.

options.title: Consolidate Redaction Hardening
options.body: Fix this together with the adjacent diagnostic-redaction security issues so Go and Worker use one reviewed policy and one regression suite for fallback credentials.

options.title: Land Focused Stop-Character Fix
options.body: Patch only the `}`/`&`/`#`/`?` suffix case in both implementations while leaving the other open redaction gaps for separate follow-up.

options.title: Defer For Security Triage
options.body: Keep this open until maintainers finish a broader security-boundary review of diagnostic redaction guarantees and exploitability.

recommendation.title: Consolidate Redaction Hardening
recommendation.body: Fix this together with the adjacent diagnostic-redaction security issues so Go and Worker use one reviewed policy and one regression suite for fallback credentials.

likelyOwner.reason: Peter Steinberger is the strongest history match for both diagnostic redaction implementations and the security documentation that defines the boundary.
